typography_visual_philosophy.statement: Typography forms a quiet editorial spatial system: an approved asymmetric display-title object, active whitespace, a narrow side rail and restrained bilingual metadata share one optical geometry with the tactile still life.

stable_typography_grammar.statement: The display title is an asymmetric object of unequal glyph scale, position and spacing rather than a centered line or uniform text box.
Approved display lettering uses controlled stroke contrast, irregular mass, custom terminals and optical counter adjustment without copying source glyphs.
Whitespace actively separates and tensions the display title, still life and metadata; minimalism may not become empty centering.
A narrow vertical Chinese/Latin rail counterbalances the title field and participates in the shared optical axes.
Small labels and body copy remain low-volume, accurately set and rhythmically spaced so they add editorial depth without promotional noise.
Latin support remains narrow and subordinate to Chinese while sharing alignment and spacing logic with the editorial label system.

variation_axes_typography.statement: Title wording and new approved glyph forms may change while preserving asymmetric mass and controlled handmade stroke behavior.
Side-rail content, metadata count and lower label rhythm may adapt, but functional tiers and active whitespace must remain legible.
Exact olive, charcoal and mineral-paper values may change while retaining muted matte contrast and quiet optical authority.

features: exact font files and paper/ink treatment

typography_content_compatibility.statement: The family needs short identity copy capable of becoming an asymmetric title object plus enough truthful support copy to establish a secondary editorial rhythm.
If target content cannot leave active whitespace or lacks an approved display-lettering asset, production must fail closed rather than substitute a centered generic font.

renderer_responsibility: exploratory display-lettering direction only through an authorized specialized synthesis route
figma_responsibility: exact live side-rail, Chinese labels, English support and paragraph copy

transfer_risks: generic beige-plus-brush-title collapse if title geometry is reduced to a font choice
editorial emptiness if support tiers are deleted rather than restrained
visual noise if metadata is enlarged or multiplied
brand leakage if exact source glyphs or side-rail copy are reused
unresolved_uncertainties: No typography-only transfer validation has proven a new asymmetric glyph system under changed content.
No specific production font family is approved for functional Chinese or Latin roles.
Whole-image approval does not establish component approval for any typography mechanism.
